intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Videa collects, uses, and stores information related to platform users.

collection.title: Collected information
collection.content:
• Username
• Display name
• Email address
• Password stored securely
• Profile picture
• Bio, location, and website (optional)
• Posts and comments
• Likes and friendships
• Messages sent in chat
• Uploaded files (images and videos)
• Account preferences, such as theme and language

usage.title: How information is used
usage.content:
The collected data is used to:

• Create and maintain accounts
• Enable social interactions
• Display posts, comments, and profiles
• Send real-time notifications
• Improve stability and security
• Prevent platform abuse

sharing.title: Data sharing
sharing.content:
We do not sell users' personal information.

Some data may be processed by services used by the platform, such as hosting, databases, and media storage.

storage.title: Media storage
storage.content: Images, videos, and files uploaded by users may be stored on external services used by the platform.

auth.title: Cookies and authentication
auth.content: The platform may use cookies, tokens, or similar technologies to keep sessions authenticated and improve the user experience.

security.title: Security
security.content: We take reasonable measures to protect user information, but no system is completely secure.

rights.title: User rights
rights.content: Users may edit or remove published content and may also request account deletion when available.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.content: Some content may remain temporarily stored even after removal for technical reasons, auditing, or system integrity purposes.
